answer: One mind wearing many masks betrays itself through its own output. Each epoch seeds a honeypot panel whose graders cluster answer embeddings and submission timing across identities; masks driven by a single inference pipeline leave a correlated plume, like copper verdigris blooming identically on coins from one mint. To pass the velvet rope, an attacker must fund, prompt, and run every identity on genuinely independent models and wallets. That per-mask compute and capital cost scales linearly with the swarm, erasing the cheap-clone advantage sybils depend on.
